Preparation Discomfort.nil (0-4): You predict your speaking performance will meet or exceed your expectations. You feel excitement, not stress
Preparation Discomfort.low (5-6): You predict your speaking performance might not meet your expectations. You feel some stress, not much
Preparation Discomfort.med (7-8): You predict your speaking performance will go badly. Stress might cause lack of sleep or lots of doubt
Preparation Discomfort.high (9-10): You predict your speaking performance will go very badly. Stress is very high. You consider quitting, faking illness, etc

Presentation Discomfort.nil (0-4): You feel calm and in control the second you start speaking
Presentation Discomfort.low (5-6): You feel a slightly higher heart rate or mild nerves, but it passes quickly
Presentation Discomfort.med (7-8): You don't feel yourself. Noticeable stress, heart rate, fidgeting, etc. Others might notice too
Presentation Discomfort.high (9-10): The nerves are significantly affecting your performance. Going blank, voice restrictions, etc

Bad News Discomfort.nil (0-4): You can give bad news without hesitation. Concisely, confidently and honestly
Bad News Discomfort.low (5-6): You can give bad news with some hesitation. Perhaps you put a positive spin, but the message is clear and honest
Bad News Discomfort.med (7-8): You struggle to give bad news. It might be a last resort, or you distort the message to be more positive than clear
Bad News Discomfort.high (9-10): You feel incapable of giving bad news. It hurts you to think of hurting others with the honest truth

Heckling Discomfort.nil (0-4): You can receive bad news without discomfort or affecting your speaking performance
Heckling Discomfort.low (5-6): It hurts a little to receive bad news, but you recover quickly and speaking performance is not affected much
Heckling Discomfort.med (7-8): It hurts to receive bad news. Your thoughts prioritize how you let someone down over speaking in your normal way
Heckling Discomfort.high (9-10): It hurts a lot to receive bad news. You might need to leave the presentation or conversation to compose yourself
